summary: Post-fix regression testing after METRO_CACHE_ROOT quoting and LSApplicationQueriesSchemes addition. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (root, players list/create/delete, weeks/current, pix get/put persist, attendance upsert flow including clearing on unattend). Frontend: Metro bundler compiles cleanly with the quoted METRO_CACHE_ROOT; home screen loads on mobile viewport (390x844) with all critical testIDs visible (summary-card, week-label, summary-total, invite-friends-btn, open-weeks-btn, open-settings-btn, share-whatsapp-btn, add-player-btn). Navigation to /add-player, /settings, /pix, /weeks all succeed. Pix screen correctly shows 'Chave Pix não cadastrada' when key is empty. app.json validated with LSApplicationQueriesSchemes: ['whatsapp']. No red screen errors, no page errors. Minor: input fields in /add-player and /settings do not expose testIDs (player-name-input, pix-key-input, save-pix-btn, pix-qr) which prevented deep form-flow automation but screens render properly.

ui_bugs.issue: TextInput 'Nome do jogador' lacks testID (expected 'player-name-input'). Save button also missing testID. Screen renders correctly.
Pix TextInputs and Save button lack testIDs (expected 'pix-key-input', 'save-pix-btn'). Screen renders correctly with proper form.
QR code container lacks testID (expected 'pix-qr'). Correctly shows empty state when no Pix key.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Repeated in console. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (styles.summaryCard, styles.card) and likely other screens using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowOffset/shadowRadius.
expo@54.0.36 (expected ~54.0.37) and expo-constants@18.0.13 (expected ~18.0.14) are slightly behind. Non-blocking; can be updated via `npx expo install --check`.

action_items: Add testIDs to form inputs/buttons in /app/frontend/app/add-player.tsx (player-name-input, save-player-btn), /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx (pix-key-input, holder-name-input, bank-input, save-pix-btn), /app/frontend/app/pix.tsx (pix-qr) for easier E2E automation.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in StyleSheet.create objects across index.tsx (summaryCard, card) and any other screens using them to remove the deprecation warning on web.
Optional: run `cd /app/frontend && npx expo install --check` to align expo and expo-constants to expected patch versions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py excludes MongoDB _id properly (via projection {'_id': 0}) - good.
All API URLs come from env (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL / MONGO_URL) - no hardcoding.
app.json now includes LSApplicationQueriesSchemes: ['whatsapp'] under ios.infoPlist - correct for whatsapp:// canOpenURL on iOS builds.
.env METRO_CACHE_ROOT is now quoted correctly and Metro bundler starts without errors.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All test-created players/pix settings were cleaned up in test teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend home + navigation verified. If deeper form-flow testing is needed later, main agent should add testIDs to the input fields listed in action_items. shadow* deprecation warnings are cosmetic only.
rca_of_issue: N/A - regression validated the two deployment-agent fixes (METRO_CACHE_ROOT quoting in frontend/.env line 5, and LSApplicationQueriesSchemes in app.json ios.infoPlist). Both fixes verified working.
